title: Superhuman performance in urology board questions by an explainable large language model enabled for context integration of the European Association of Urology guidelines: the UroBot study

live_model.evidence: Sec 2.2: "the OpenAI text generation API was used with the models 'gpt-3.5-turbo-0125', 'gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09' and 'gpt-4o-2024-05-13'"; Table 1: GPT-4o RoCA=0.776 (95% CI 0.771-0.781), GPT-4=0.722

prompt.location: "The exact prompts utilised in this study can be accessed in the Supplementary Material"; code/instructions on GitHub (github.com/marjohe/UroBot)
prompt.note: Prompt is not printed in the main text, only referenced as available via supplement/repo.

claim.metric: mean Rate of Correct Answers (RoCA), GPT-4o
claim.location: Table 1, GPT-4o column; 200 EBU ISA questions x 10 runs

data.source: 200 European Board of Urology In-Service Assessment (ISA) questions -- "confidential and only obtainable through purchase on the official EBU website"

notes: gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (labelled "GPT-4") is run identically, RoCA=0.722. Everything else about this paper is strong (dated snapshots, code/prompts on GitHub, clean numbers, 10-run Fleiss' Kappa consistency) but the EBU question bank must be purchased, so the exact test items are not obtainable from the public record.
